intake.title: Intake
intake.description: Review incoming orders, confirm physical intake, and decide which verified orders can enter production.
intake.workspaceDescription: Record physical intake and release verified work.
intake.emptyTitle: No orders in this intake state
intake.emptyDescription: Accepted orders will appear here when they need physical intake or are ready for production.
intake.emptyFilteredDescription: Clear a filter or search for a different order or customer.
intake.presslyDecisionDescription: Due date shows urgency. Only released orders can enter Production.
intake.releaseDescription: {{customer}} will become production-ready in Pressly. If bag intake is missing, the order will stay in Intake until it is recorded.
intake.optionalBagCount: Bag count can be added now or after release.
intake.invalidBagCount: Bag count must be a whole number of zero or more.

errors.loadFailed: Incoming orders could not be loaded. Check the connection and refresh Intake.
errors.changed: This order changed while intake was open. The current order has been loaded; review it before recording again.
errors.noLongerPending: This order has already left bag intake. The current order list has been loaded.
errors.orderMissing: This order is no longer available for bag intake. The current order list has been loaded.
errors.bagCountRejected: The server rejected this bag count. Enter a whole number of zero or more and record intake again.
errors.admissionCommitted: This order is already selected or placed for production. Remove that commitment before undoing the manual release.
errors.sourceWithdrawn: The order source withdrew this order, so it cannot be released to Production.
errors.sourceAlreadyReleased: The source now considers this order production-ready. Refresh to review its current state.
errors.admissionChanged: The order's production readiness changed before this action completed. Review the refreshed order before trying again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before recording bag intake.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot record bag intake. Ask an owner, manager, or production operator for access.
errors.unavailable: LPMS could not confirm the final intake state. Review the refreshed bag count and priority before trying again.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned order data that Processor could not read. Refresh before recording intake.
errors.recordFailed: Bag intake was not confirmed. Review the refreshed order before trying again.
